name: Frank Slootman
current_role: Chairman of the Board, Snowflake Inc.; independent director, Nscale (AI data-centre company, since Oct 2026)
profile: Dutch-born software executive who took three companies public: Data Domain (sold to EMC for $1.8B in 2009), ServiceNow (2012 IPO) and Snowflake (record 2020 IPO). Stepped down as Snowflake CEO in Feb 2024 but remains chairman; in Oct 2026 joined the board of UK AI-infrastructure firm Nscale. Author of 'Amp It Up' (2022).
interesting_fact: Before taking the Snowflake CEO job in 2019 he was retired and racing sailboats competitively in the San Francisco Bay Area; in Oct 2026 he joined the board of AI data-centre builder Nscale, highly relevant to a data-center podcast.
deep_cut_fact: Son of a military veteran and a portrait artist, he raced sailing dinghies as a boy, was a standout economics student at Erasmus University Rotterdam, and finished early to chase US internships - his dream employer was IBM. 'Amp It Up' began as a 2018 LinkedIn article.
notes: Snowflake press contact is a corporate route; Nscale board role is the natural hook for an energy/data-center podcast. Has appeared on podcasts promoting 'Amp It Up' so is media-accessible.

name: Xiao Yongming
current_role: Founder and former controlling shareholder of Zangge Mining (000408.SZ); control transferred to Zijin Mining in 2025
profile: Sichuan-born entrepreneur who ran a plastics factory in Anyue County before moving to Golmud, Qinghai, and founding Golmud Zangge Potash in 2002. Zangge Mining (potassium chloride, lithium carbonate, stake in Tibet Julong Copper) listed via backdoor in 2016. In 2025 the family agreed to sell control (25%) to Zijin Mining; his sons Xiao Yao and Xiao Ning have led the company.
interesting_fact: He moved to Golmud in 1996 to work in catering, then jumped into potash in 2002; by 2016 Hurun ranked him the richest person in Qinghai with 26.5 billion yuan.
deep_cut_fact: In 1981, aged about 17, he started at the Yonghong Plastics Factory in Anyue County, Sichuan, rising to factory director; the family's Sichuan Yonghong Industrial still carries that name.
notes: Sensitive: detained in 2021 (illegal-mining probe) and under residential surveillance Apr-Oct 2024 (lifted); avoid in outreach. Control of Zangge sold to Zijin (deal signed Jan 2025, https://www.jiemian.com/article/12253064.html). No personal media presence; any route would be via Zangge board secretary office.
